title: Input and output
description:
Write a program that asks for a name and a birth year, then greets the person and says how old they turn in 2026:

```
Name? Ada
Birth year? 1990
Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.
```

The prompts are written with `Console.Write` (no new line); the input after them comes from the person typing. Use `int.Parse` for the year.
hints: `Console.ReadLine()` returns `string?`; the `!` after it says "I know there is a line here".
`int.Parse(text)` turns `"1990"` into the number 1990, so you can subtract it from 2026.

examples.name: Ada
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.

examples.name: a recent year
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Grace Hopper!
In 2026 you turn 16.
